voice.name: Martin - Ultra High Quality
voice.why: Odilon Ferrand's own voice (Martin) for the rumors he passes on from the square's bench: the same calm man who talks to a player, so a rumor overheard on the bench sounds like him.

odilon_mine.text: The mine at Coalman's Brow takes anyone with a pick and a strong back. The coal goes down to the power plant on the edge of town.

odilon_sawmill.text: The sawmill is always short a pair of hands. Logs come in from the woodlot, boards go out, and the foreman asks few questions.

odilon_orchard.text: Pick apples at the orchard, press them for juice, and the market buys what you carry. I did it myself the summer my knees went.

odilon_smokehouse.text: The smokehouse by the dock pays a fair price for fish. Bring it fresh and nobody will haggle.

odilon_market.text: Set up at the market on a good morning and the whole town buys. Bread, honey, apples, whatever you carry.

odilon_harbor.text: The harbor master keeps a tally of every crate that lands. Honest work, if you can count and stay awake.

odilon_parcel.text: The post office wants couriers. Walk a parcel across town, earn a little, and learn every street on the way.

odilon_pond.text: There is a pond past the houses where the carp sit lazy at noon. I fished it for years and never needed a boat.

odilon_church.text: The church is open to anyone. The bell rings the hour, and the priest knows more about this town than the baker does.
